p.i: A revelation given at Kirtland, Ohio, 9 March 1833, through Joseph Smith Jr. concerning the Apocrypha.

chapter.li: LEChapter91 Verse1 Truly thus says the Lord unto you concerning the Apocrypha: There are many things contained therein that are true, and it is mostly translated correctly. VerseEnd Verse2 There are many things contained therein that are not true, which are interpolations by the hands of men. VerseEnd Verse3 Truly I say unto you that it is not needful that the Apocrypha should be translated. VerseEnd Verse4 Therefore, whoever reads it, let him understand, for the spirit manifests truth, VerseEnd Verse5 and whoever is enlightened by the spirit shall obtain benefit therefrom, VerseEnd Verse6 and whoever receives not the spirit cannot be benefited; therefore, it is not needful that it should be translated. Amen. VerseEnd
